target_audience: High school students interested in math competitions/algorithms

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Angular Sweep
lecture_lines: Imagine a line rotating around a pivot point.
The Windmill problem uses this rotation strategy.
A line strikes points in a set.
animations: Create a central pivot point labeled 'P' in #FFFFFF color.
Draw a set of lines through 'P' colored #FF4500 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg].
Animate the lines rotating clockwise around 'P'.

sections.title: Defining the Windmill Mechanics
lecture_lines: We pick a point as the pivot.
The line rotates until it hits another point.
That second point becomes the new pivot.
animations: Display windmill blades labeled 'B1', 'B2', 'B3' in #00CED1 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg].
Rotate blades 30 degrees around central pivot 'P' of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg].
Highlight pivot 'P' of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] with a glowing effect in #FFFF00.

sections.title: Key Property: The Invariant of Order
lecture_lines: The rotation order depends on initial angle.
Geometry determines the sequence of points hit.
We can predict every pivot swap.
animations: Show clockwise and counter-clockwise orders of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blades.svg].
Demonstrate order invariance using colored arcs in #32CD32 around the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blades.svg].
Confirm the invariant persists after a rotation of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blades.svg].

sections.title: Visualization of the Rotation
lecture_lines: First, select an initial pivot point.
Calculate angles to all other points.
Rotate the line to the smallest angle.
Update the pivot to the hit point.
Repeat this process for the full set.
animations: Animate the windmill rotation step-by-step using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg].
Trace the path of each blade of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] with a #FF00FF line.
Finalize the rotation cycle of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] to show state preservation.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: The Windmill strategy is efficient to compute.
It helps robots navigate complex environments.
Sensors use this to cover every area.
animations: Summarize key points: Sweep, Pivot, Invariant.
Display a real-world windmill icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/windmill.svg] labeled 'W' in #FFA500.
End with the final state labeled 'Invariant' in #FFFFFF.
